1 Executive Summary & Technical Architecture
Developer: Muhammad Afaq
Roll Number: FA23-BSE-012
Course: CSC336 Web Technologies
CLO Evaluated: CLO 2 (Client-Side Front-End)

QuizMaster Pro is an enterprise-grade interactive single-page educational quiz application developed to fulfill all criteria for CSC336 Web Technologies Assignment 2. Built strictly without heavy frameworks, it utilizes vanilla HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+, and Bootstrap 5 to demonstrate complete mastery over DOM manipulation, asynchronous state management, responsive flex/grid layouts, browser audio synthesis, and client-side vector PDF generation.

4 Instant Answer Validation & Early Exit Feature
Figure 6: Real-Time Answer Feedback & Explanation Interaction: Instant Feedback
When an answer is selected, options are immediately locked, the correct answer is highlighted in green, the wrong answer (if selected) is highlighted in red, and an educational explanation card appears below.
Figure 7: Early Exit Modal with Partial Progress PDF Export Feature: Exit Quiz Back Dialog
Clicking the "Exit Quiz" back button displays this modal showing exact questions attempted. The candidate can choose to resume, return home, or click Save & Get PDF to download a formal report of whatever was done.
5 Performance Dashboard & Comprehensive Answer Review
Figure 8: Performance Analytics Dashboard (Download Button on Right Side) Section 5: Results View
Features the dynamic SVG Donut chart, accuracy percentage, score fraction, 4 metric cards (Correct, Incorrect, Unanswered, Time Taken), Topic performance progress bars, and the Download PDF Report button aligned on the right side.
Figure 9: Comprehensive Answer Review Screen Section 6: Review View
Provides deep post-quiz review with interactive filter pills (All Questions, Correct Only, Incorrect Only, Unanswered), question-by-question breakdowns, and detailed educational rationales.
